Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Party moderation

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

The current host can open the party panel with Escape, select a remote player by name/seat and press Remove and block rejoin. Guests cannot invoke the operation for another player, and the host is excluded from the selector. The panel reports pending, completed or unconfirmed removal. The selector follows authoritative name changes and checks that the chosen connection still matches before submitting. Removed clients close gameplay and see an explicit notice. The existing kick(seat) method follows the same permission and removal path as the button.

Direct sessions store the token ban in complete gameplay checkpoints. Coordinated Room sessions first disable the exact enrolled member at the coordinator, then retire gameplay and successor eligibility. An already prepared removed successor cannot take over. A replacement trusted member may receive the next checkpoint and continue through planned or abrupt host loss. Old saves do not restore the disabled enrollment's permission.

The block applies to this session/party identity, not a person's account. A fresh independently authorized identity is separate, and existing invites are not revoked automatically. Coordinated removal requires a service supporting the new optional operation; unsupported services produce a bounded failure without silently claiming removal. Re-enabling an enrollment is a trusted service-administration operation; this game does not expose an unban control.

Game content, World, gameplay actions and save formats are unchanged. The owner profile shares this frontend; the moderation acceptance fixture currently exercises the C9 profile with native ENet and Chrome/WebRTC.
